stories.title: Russia's MOEX Index Little Changed as Stocks Close Lower
stories.summary: Russian stocks closed lower in the latest session, Investing.com reports. Despite the decline, the MOEX Russia Index itself ended little changed. The report gives no breakdown of which sectors or stocks drove the move.
stories.whyItMatters: Russian equities sit mostly outside Western capital flows, so the move signals local risk sentiment rather than global market direction.
whatToWatch: Next MOEX close for a clearer trend
Oil-price or sanctions news that could move Russian equities
questions: Which stocks or sectors led the decline?
Why did the index close flat while stocks fell?

stories.title: UK Reportedly Set to Impose Levies on Chinese EVs
stories.summary: The UK is reportedly preparing levies on Chinese electric vehicles, Investing.com reports. The move follows trade pressure tied to the EU's own actions on Chinese EV imports. The size and timing of the UK levies are not yet confirmed.
stories.whyItMatters: Tariffs on Chinese EVs would affect automakers and battery suppliers, and could add to broader EU-China trade tension.
whatToWatch: Official UK government confirmation of the levies
China's response to any new tariff
questions: How large would the UK levy be?
Which companies face the most exposure?

stories.title: Ex-Anthropic Researcher Coxon to Testify at NYC AI Hearing

stories.whyItMatters: Regulatory hearings on AI can shape policy affecting major AI firms, including Anthropic and its competitors, with knock-on effects for AI-exposed stocks.

stories.title: Leftist and Nationalist Candidates Lead Bosnia Presidency Election
stories.summary: Leftist and nationalist candidates are leading in the election for Bosnia's tripartite presidency, Investing.com reports. Bosnia's presidency rotates among three members representing its main ethnic groups. Final results are not yet confirmed.
stories.whyItMatters: Political shifts in Bosnia can affect regional stability in the Balkans, a factor investors watch for broader European risk sentiment.
whatToWatch: Final official election results
Formation of a new presidency and government
questions: Which specific candidates are leading in each seat?
What policy changes might follow a leftist or nationalist win?

stories.title: Schneider Electric Nears $20 Billion Deal for PTC, Report Says
stories.summary: Schneider Electric is reportedly close to a roughly $20 billion deal to acquire U.S. software maker PTC, Investing.com reports. Terms and timing of a final agreement are not yet confirmed.
stories.whyItMatters: A deal of this size would be one of the largest industrial software acquisitions of the year, reshaping competition in industrial design and IoT software.
whatToWatch: Official confirmation or denial from Schneider Electric or PTC
Deal terms and structure once announced
Regulatory review timeline
questions: What premium would Schneider pay for PTC?
How would the deal affect PTC's existing partnerships?

stories.title: Delfin to Tender Full 17.6% Monte dei Paschi Stake to Intesa
stories.summary: Delfin plans to tender its entire 17.6% stake in Monte dei Paschi into Intesa Sanpaolo's takeover offer, Investing.com reports. The move backs Intesa's bid for the Italian bank. Further details on the offer's terms are not given.
stories.whyItMatters: A major shareholder's full tender support strengthens the odds of Intesa's takeover succeeding, a deal that would reshape Italy's banking sector.
whatToWatch: Other large shareholders' tender decisions
Official close of Intesa's offer period
Regulatory approval of the takeover
questions: What stake level does Intesa need for the deal to succeed?
How will the combined bank affect Italian market share?
